articles.summary: IBM announced self-hosted deployment for IBM Bob, allowing organizations to bring AI software development to on-premises, private-cloud, sovereign-cloud, and air-gapped environments where they have control.
articles.title: IBM Introduces Self-Hosted Deployment for IBM Bob to Help Enterprises Advance AI Sovereignty and Governance

articles.summary: IBM will hold its quarterly conference call to discuss its third-quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, October 21, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. ET.
articles.title: IBM to Announce Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results

articles.summary: The IBM board of directors has elected Frank Baker to the board, effective October 1, 2026.
articles.title: IBM Elects Frank Baker to its Board of Directors

articles.summary: Providence worked with IBM Consulting to rethink how people move into new roles. With the help of AI and automation, hiring managers reduced administrative effort by 90%, while internal caregivers now start their new roles on average 12 days sooner. Providence also lowered transfer costs by 60% and improved process accuracy by up to 70%.
articles.title: Providence Collaborates with IBM Using AI to Reduce Hiring Admin Time Without Replacing a Single System

articles.title: IBM Teams Up with SAP to Help Businesses Modernize Operations and Advance AI-Readiness
